proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2998 *kākka expressly gives Nepali kāko and B./H. kākā father’s younger brother. The survey kin term matches this exact relationship without collapsing other uncle terms. Discovery comparator: Dm kākā “father’s younger brother” (f_i7bb4ud74dlt4). The full primary entry was reviewed independently of the existing match. Exact survey forms are preserved.
